I am Etiënne Thomassen and this is my **personal** website.

I am a forest ecologist and forester at [Bosgroep Zuid Nederland](https://bosgroepen.nl/bosgroep-zuid-nederland/) and a PhD candidate at [Wageningen University](https://wur.nl/en/). I am interested in the growth and development of forests and how to steer those processes. Currently, I am mainly working on the topics of forest climate adaptation and enhancing resilience of forests.
